families.topic: local LTBI testing and treatment programmes for migrants
families.page_title: Latent TB infection (LTBI): testing and treatment
evidence_points: The publication advises commissioners and practitioners implementing local latent TB infection testing and treatment for migrants.
It brings together NICE guidance, research and learning from areas that have implemented or piloted LTBI programmes.
It describes who should be tested, where and how testing should occur, and programme funding and data-return requirements.
The page was last updated in December 2025 and removed outdated materials pending inclusion in an updated document.

evidence_points: The leaflet is for visa applicants whose pre-entry result did not show active pulmonary tuberculosis.
It explains that a negative active-TB screen does not exclude latent TB infection.
It directs eligible people to consider latent TB testing after arrival in the UK.

families.source: UKHSA latent TB occupational-prevalence rapid review
families.topic: latent TB prevalence in occupations with prolonged indoor contact with cattle
evidence_points: The rapid review examined latent TB prevalence in occupational groups with prolonged indoor contact with cows.
It covered farmers, farm workers, veterinarians, abattoir workers and similar occupational groups.
The review included three studies concerning screening after bovine TB herd outbreaks.
The evidence base was limited to research identified for the UK, Ireland and Western Europe.
